老舅推心传要义外甥顿首受真言（老舅推心传要义外甥顿首受真言（第22页）“你把陛下当什么了？把天庭当什么了？这雷部正印是何等要紧的职司，是你能拿来做人情的？是我想当就能当的？”他冷笑一声，“退一万步说，就算陛下被你小子灌了迷魂汤，真让我坐了这个位子，你觉得我能坐得稳？”“你怎么知道今天我了帮你，明天我不会帮广成子？那可是我的亲师兄，挚爱亲朋，手足兄弟。”黄龙的语气忽然淡了下来：“我在火部这么多年，修为不如人，本事不如人，胆子也不如人。为啥陛下还用我？”“就是因为我怂。我不掺和那些打生打死的破事，我也从不得罪人。谁赢了我都是黄龙真人，谁输了我还是黄龙真人。”他抬起头，看着苏元：“可雷部是陛下手中最锋利的剑，雷部部长，要的不是圆滑世故，不是八面玲珑。你不得罪人，你当什么雷部部长？”这番话，掷地有声。苏元被他骂得沉默了。他靠在椅背上，脑子里却不自觉地浮现出方才闻仲丢给他的那堆积如山的玉简，光是想一想，便觉得头皮发麻。他之前总觉得自己脑子够快，手段够多，算计够深。在这三界官场里头，论实务、论机变、论揣摩上意，自己样样都拔尖。别说一部部长，便是那四御帝君的位子，他嘴上不说，心里也未尝没想过，自己除了修为不够，其他哪一样不够格？可今日上了帝君府，在这张老脸面前，他才发现自己在真正的官场智慧面前是何等的稚嫩。人家几句话便能拨云见日，自己琢磨了半天还在原地打转。不由得有点灰心丧气，像是被戳破了气的皮球，蔫蔫地靠在椅背上。“这不是得不得罪人的事，我多大本事我自己知道，这摊子太大了，我怕撑不起来。”“一多，不如一少，这里面的玄奥，你就慢慢悟吧。”黄龙挥了挥手，“你那个小兄弟，马上就到了。”苏元正自琢磨他这句“一多不如一少”是什么意思，堂屋外头便响起一个中气十足的声音。“苏部！属下崇应鸾，前来报到！”黄龙冲苏元努了努嘴，但苏元却故意端着架子，学着太师的样子，屈指一弹，一道劲风打在门上。那两扇大门纹丝没动。黄龙憋着笑，苏元干咳了一声，又弹了一指，门还是没动。外头崇应鸾又喊了一声：“苏部？你在里面吗？”苏元老脸微微一红，黄龙终于没忍住，一挥袖子，一道清光拂过，堂屋大门这才吱呀呀地朝两侧敞开。崇应鸾快步而入，目不斜视，先给苏元见礼，又转过身，朝黄龙请了个安。苏元也不客套，待他行完了礼，便开门见山。“斩仙台的事，要处理干净。交给你来办，有没有把握？”斩仙台这些年一直被雷部某些人当成了敛财的私产，苏元要清理，这话虽没把话说透，但人精般的崇应鸾自然明白。崇应鸾目光在苏元脸上停了一瞬，又移开了，短暂犹豫过后，很快便咬了咬牙，深吸一口气，重重点头：“有把握！”“好。你打算怎么办？”……“什么叫他妈的你御下不严？自请发落？”……“我什么时候说要你替我抗这件事了？你还给自己感动上了？”……“我他妈怎么带出你这么个死脑筋的兵？”……“你懂不懂什么叫处置，什么叫擦屁股？”

The old uncle's advice on the essentials of the heart-to-heart transfer to my nephew suddenly received the mantra (page 22) "What do you take your majesty for? What do you take for the heavenly court? What an important task it is to have the official seal of the Ministry of Thunder. Is it something you can use as a favor?" He sneered and said, "Even if Your Majesty gets drunk on you, do you think I can sit in this position?" "How do you know that I will help you today, but I will not help Guangchengzi tomorrow? He is my senior brother, my dearest friend, my brother." Huang Long's tone suddenly softened: "I have been in the Ministry of Fire for so many years, but my cultivation is not as good as others, my ability is not as good as others, and my courage is not as good as others. Why does Your Majesty still use me?" "It's because I'm a coward. I don't get involved in those messy things that involve life and death, and I never offend anyone. Whoever wins, I will be Master Huang Long. If I lose, I will still be Master Huang Long." He raised his head and looked at Su Yuan: "But Lei Bu is the sharpest sword in your Majesty's hand. Minister Lei does not want to be tactful and smart. If you don't want to offend others, what kind of minister do you think you are?" These words were very powerful. Su Yuan was silenced by his scolding. He leaned back on the chair, but the pile of jade slips that Wen Zhong had just thrown to him appeared in his mind. His scalp felt numb. He had always thought that he was quick-witted, had enough tricks, and was calculating enough. In the three worlds of officialdom, he was top-notch in terms of practice, change, and understanding of superior intentions. Not to mention the position of the Fourth Imperial Emperor, he did not say it in his mouth, nor did he think in his heart that he was not qualified in any other way except for his lack of cultivation. But today, in front of this old face, he realized that he was not qualified. How immature he is in the face of real officialdom wisdom. A few words can clear the air, but I am still thinking about it for a long time. I can't help but feel a little discouraged, like a ball that has been punctured. Lean back on the chair. "This is not something that can offend others. I know how capable I am. This stall is too big and I'm afraid I won't be able to hold it up." "One more is not as good as one less. You should slowly understand the mystery behind this." "Huang Long waved his hand, "Your little brother will be here soon." Su Yuan was wondering what he meant by "one more is not as good as one few" when a strong voice sounded outside the hall. "Su Bu! Subordinate Chong Yingluan, come and report!" Huang Long nuzzled at Su Yuan, but Su Yuan deliberately acted like a grand master, and with a flick of his finger, a strong wind hit the door. The two doors did not move at all. Huang Long held it in. With a smile, Su Yuan coughed dryly and flicked his fingers again, but the door still didn't move. Chong Yingluan called out again: "Su Bu? Are you in there?" Su Yuan's face turned slightly red. Huang Long finally couldn't hold it back and waved his sleeves. A ray of clear light passed by, and the door of the main room creaked open on both sides. Chong Yingluan walked in quickly, without squinting. He first greeted Su Yuan, then turned around and said hello to Huang Long, waiting for him to finish. Li, he went straight to the point. "The matter of Zhanxian Terrace must be dealt with. I'll leave it to you. Are you sure?" Su Yuan wanted to clean up the Xiantai Terrace. Although he didn't say it clearly, Chong Yingluan, who was like a human being, naturally understood. After a brief hesitation, he gritted his teeth, took a deep breath, and nodded heavily: "I'm sure.! ""good. What are you going to do? "..."What the hell do you mean you are not strict with your subordinates? Asking for help? "..."When did I say I wanted you to fight this for me? Have you ever moved yourself? "..."How the hell could I bring out such a brainless soldier like you? "..."Do you know what disposal is and what wiping one's butt is? "
